messages.author: bfa4a88c8a5bc54e
messages.subject: New error messages in nimble 0.13.0
parts:
Hi all,

I can provide a reproducible example if needed, but I've had this error twice now with models that used to run without problem:

Error in if (calculate) { : the condition has length > 1

It resolves when I switch from "calculate = F" to "calculate = T" in nimbleModel(). 

I also tried to get dependencies for simulation using the following line of code which used to work: 

m1model$getDependencies(c("alpha", "beta", "psi", "phi"), self = F)

which now yields the error:

Error in if (!self) { : the condition has length > 1

I think this started with the new version of nimble?

Let me know if I need to provide an example!

Matt

messages.author: dd632bd3bbcdd7e9
messages.subject: Re: New error messages in nimble 0.13.0
parts:
Hi Matt,

This looks pretty baffling.  I just want to ask if there is any possibility that the value of "F" has been modified in your R session?  TRUE and FALSE are safer than T and F because the latter can be over-written in an R session but the former cannot.  And it would explain two unrelated errors both from providing "F" as an argument.  If that's not it, please do send a reproducible example (off-list, if you prefer).

Thanks
Perry
